criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

criteria.feedback: Missing or incorrect prediction. Trace the example and check JSON types, then retry.

criteria.description: Write a complete GET /products/4 HTTP/1.1 request with Host in requests.http. Include the blank line and explain why the path is not the method. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add a POST /products request with Content-Type application/json and name/price/stock body. Include a matching 201 response with Location. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Write response examples for malformed input (400), missing authentication (401), forbidden access (403), missing resource (404), and server error (500). Explain a scenario for each. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Describe replacing a complete product with PUT versus changing stock with PATCH. Give request bodies and explicitly state your API’s required fields. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Apply PUT stock=5 twice to stock 10, then compare two POST sale quantity=2 operations starting at 10. Record final stocks and explain idempotency. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use the local server from Lesson 10 and browser tools to save one request/response pair. Identify header/body boundaries and explain Content-Type. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Define a JSON error body with code, message and field errors. Give an invalid-stock example, ensuring it provides no stack trace or secret values. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
